text: blue: Or, violet | red, and blue, and white, and black marble: Or, of porphyre, and marble, and alabaster, and stone of blue color
royal wine: Heb. wine of the kingdom | state of the king: Heb. according to the hand of the king
fair to look on: Heb. good of countenance
by his chamberlains: Heb. which was by the hand of his Eunuchs
what shall we do: Heb. what to do?
if it please the king: Heb. if it be good with the king | from him: Heb. from before him | that it be not altered: Heb. that it pass not away | unto another: Heb. unto her companion
pleased the king: Heb. was good in the eyes of the king
that it should be published according to the language of every people: Heb. that one should publish it according to the language of his people
